servers.title: Smartup servers
servers.emptyText: Add the Smartup server your clients sign in through.
servers.name: Name

fields.codeHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphen, 2 to 31 characters. Matches the code in Smartup and never changes.
fields.name: Name
fields.baseUrlHint: Smartup Web address without a path, for example https://smartup.example.uz
fields.issuerHint: OpenID Connect issuer. The portal loads the discovery document from it.
fields.clientSecretHint: Issued when the portal is registered in Smartup.
fields.clientSecretSetHint: The secret is set. Leave the field empty to keep it.
fields.isDefault: Default server: clients of the shared cloud see its button
fields.roleMapHint: One role per line: Smartup role = client_user or client_admin. For example: director = client_admin
fields.endpointsHint: Fill in all four endpoints only if the server has no discovery document.

servers.callbackHint: Give it to the Smartup developers when registering the portal on this server.
servers.checkNever: The server has not been checked yet.
servers.checkOk: Server responds: sign-in through it is set up correctly.

issues.unreachable: The server does not respond or responded with an error.
issues.timeout: The server did not respond within 5 seconds.
issues.not_json: The server did not respond with a JSON document.
issues.issuer_mismatch: The sign-in server address in the document does not match the address in the registry.
issues.no_authorization_endpoint: The document has no authorization endpoint.
issues.no_token_endpoint: The document has no token endpoint.
issues.no_userinfo_endpoint: The document has no user info endpoint.
issues.no_jwks: There is no keys endpoint, or it does not return keys.
issues.no_pkce_s256: The server does not support PKCE S256.

telegram.invalid: This link no longer works. A link from the bot works once and for 10 minutes. Request a new one in the bot.

loginLink.subject: Sign in to Smartup Hub
loginLink.text:
Hello,

To sign in to Smartup Hub, open the link and press "Sign in":
{url}

The link works for {minutes} minutes and only once. If you did not ask to sign in, just delete this email.

confirmEmail.subject: Confirm your address for Smartup Hub
confirmEmail.text:
Hello,

To sign in to Smartup Hub with a link sent to this address, open the link and press "Confirm address":
{url}

The link works for {minutes} minutes. If you did not enter this address, just delete this email: an unconfirmed address is not linked to anything.

invitation.subject: Invitation to Smartup Hub
invitation.text:
Hello,

{inviterName} invites you to the organization {orgName} in Smartup Hub, the Smartup support portal.

To accept the invitation, open the link and press "Accept":
{url}

The invitation is valid for {days} days.

telegramLinked.subject: Telegram is linked to Smartup Hub
telegramLinked.text:
Hello,

The Telegram account {account} is now linked to your Smartup Hub account. It can be used to sign in to the portal.

If this was not you, unlink it in your profile:
{url}

staffInvitation.subject: Invitation to the Smartup Hub workspace
staffInvitation.text:
Hello!

{inviterName} invites you to the workspace of Smartup Hub, the Smartup support portal.

Open the link, set a password and connect the second sign-in factor:
{url}

The link works for {hours} hours and only once. Do not forward it to anyone.

staffReset.subject: Your Smartup Hub access was reset
staffReset.text:
Hello!

The portal administrator reset your password and second sign-in factor in Smartup Hub. All your sessions have been ended.

Open the link, set a new password and connect the second factor again:
{url}

The link works for {hours} hours and only once. If you did not ask for a reset, tell the administrator.
